log_file.description: Path to the log file for OsmoMSC.

log_level.description: Logging level (dso, lld, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency).

log_color.description: Enable colored log output in terminals.

ctrl_bind_addr.description: IP address for the control interface.

ctrl_port.description: TCP port for the control interface.

vty_bind_addr.description: IP address for the VTY (local CLI) interface.

vty_port.description: TCP port for the VTY (local CLI) interface.

a_interface_bind_ip.description: IP address to bind the A-interface (BSSAP over IP).

a_interface_ccm_ip.description: IP address for CCM (Circuit Configuration Management) on A-interface.

bscs.description: List of BSCs (BSS) connected via A-interface.

rtp_ip.description: IP used for RTP media negotiation (optional).

dscp.description: DSCP value for BSC signaling QoS.

lac.description: Location Area Code (LAC) used by this BSC.

ci.description: Cell Identity (CI) base for this BSC (if static).

mgw_name.description: Name of the MGW this BSC uses.

sccp_address.description: SCCP address (e.g., 'PC=12345') for SCCP routing; leave empty for default.

iu_cs_mgw_rtcp.description: Enable RTCP for media monitoring on Iu-CS (UMTS).

rncs.description: List of RNCs (UTRAN) connected via Iu-CS interface.

rtp_ip.description: IP used for RTP media negotiation (optional).

dscp.description: DSCP value for RNC signaling QoS.

mgw_name.description: Name of the MGW this RNC uses.

sccp_address.description: SCCP address for SCCP routing; leave empty for default.

msc_name.description: Name of this MSC instance (used for identification).

msc_uuid.description: UUID of this MSC (if managed by external system); auto-generated if empty.

cs7_instance.description: SS7 instance number for this MSC.

hlr_bind_addr.description: IP address to bind HLR (HLR over GSv interface).

hlr_port.description: TCP port for HLR interface (GSv protocol).

auth_policy_auth_optional.description: If true, authentication is optional (e.g., for open networks).

smpps.description: List of SMPP sessions for SMS delivery.

smsc_default_smsc_id.description: Default SMS-C ID for outgoing SMS.

smsc_default_source_addr.description: Default source address (e.g., short code) for outgoing SMS.

cs7_point_code.description: Point Code (PC) of this MSC in SS7 (dotted format for 14-bit).

default_lac.description: Default LAC for routing when no LAC is provided.

imsi_prefixes.description: IMSI prefix-based routing rules (e.g., for multi-tenant or roaming).

smpp_rate_limit.description: Max SMS per second per SMPP session.

ss7_congestion.description: Enable SS7 congestion control (e.g., backpressure on signaling).

mgw_default_name.description: Name of the default media gateway.

mgw_local_ip.description: Local IP for MGW endpoint (for media streaming).

mgw_remote_ip.description: Remote IP (e.g., BSC/RNC) for media negotiation; leave 0.0.0.0 for dynamic.

mgw_sdp_offer.description: If true, MGW offers SDP in early media.

mgw_rtcp.description: Enable RTCP for media quality monitoring.

codecs.description: List of supported audio codecs for voice calls.

cli_password.description: Password for VTY/CLI login (insecure in plaintext — use only on localhost).
